item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan sangs rgyas gling pas rab brtan phag lo'i zla tshes nyin par la/ rong bzhi sbas pa'i shar phyogs gnas chen ri yi byang phyogs nyi ma rang shar gnas kyi g.yon phyogs mkha' 'gro seng gdong phug nas/ rigs mthun gyi Dak+ki karma mu tra grogs bcas spyan drangs shing / slar zla tshes la bsod nams can stobs kyi rgyal po'i pho brang chen po drug zur rnam rgyal rdzong gi dbus rtse nas mkha' 'gro'i shog ser bod yig du (tu) phab grub pa bgyis so//
